in_arabic.name: زهرान
in_arabic.meaning: زهران تعني الازدهار و النمو و التفتح
in_arabic.long_meaning: زهران هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الازدهار و النمو و التفتح, و هو مشتق من الفعل زهر الذي يعني التفتح و الازدهار. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة و الرائعة التي تحمل معاني إيجابية و محمودة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: زہران
in_urdu.meaning: زہران کا مطلب ہے کھلنا، فروغ پزیر ہونا
in_urdu.long_meaning: زہران ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر اسم ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کھلنا، فروغ پزیر ہونا۔ یہ فعل زہر سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کھلنا، پھلنا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام خوبصورت اور عظیم معانیを持つ ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़हरान
in_hindi.meaning: ज़हरान का अर्थ है खिलना, विकास करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़हरान एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है खिलना, विकास करना। यह क्रिया ज़हर से व्युत्पन्न है जिसका अर्थ है खिलना, फूलना। इस्लामी संस्कृति में, यह नाम सुंदर और महान अर्थों वाले नामों में से एक है।

in_english.name: Zahran
in_english.long_meaning: Zahran is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning blooming, flourishing, or shining. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'zahara,' which means to bloom, flower, or become apparent. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant cultural and spiritual importance, symbolizing growth, prosperity, and radiance. The name Zahran is often associated with positive personality traits such as charisma, optimism, and creativity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zahran has been passed down through generations, resonating with the cultural essence of the Arab world. It encapsulates the essence of a flourishing society, reminding us of the importance of nurturing our skills, knowledge, and relationships. The prefix “Zah-” in the name signifies "growth," emphasizing the significance of continuous progress. This focus on growth and development has been a cornerstone of Islamic culture, where intellectual, emotional, and spiritual advancement is encouraged and celebrated.
data.spiritual_significance: Zahran bears a great spiritual significance, alluding to the multifaceted nature of Allah and the beauty of His Creation. The root meaning of "zahara" in Arabic means "to shine, be radiant, or to adorn." This denotes the beauty and splendor of divine Providence, which we should recognize and appreciate. The name also echoes the concept of "zahr" meaning "beautiful and fragrant gardens," alluding to the lush, verdant Paradise that Allah has prepared for His Beloved Servants.
